content:
You can change the chart type of the timeline by selecting a different option from the chart
type dropdown menu. The available chart types include:
Line chart
Column chart
Pie chart
The timeline only appears if the following conditions are met:
There are more than 40 events in your results.
There's Timestamp  or timeGenerated  column.
